description:
Represents Microsoft Defender for Identity sensors that are ready to be activated.

TIP: Gets a specific sensor candidate by ID. Returns full discovery metadata: dnsName, ipAddress, osVersion, candidateType, lastSeenDateTime, isActivated, detectedBy, additionalInformation (server role hints). Use before calling activate-sensor-candidates to confirm the candidate matches the expected server.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-sensor-candidate
